design_basis: Prior audit found that small defects did not control rupture and laboratory-frame Langevin drag contaminated rapid loading. Larger transverse missing-site slits provide a testable stress-concentration contrast; slower loading limits flow contamination. Predictions are hypotheses, not guaranteed outcomes.

families.name: interior-dominant hypothesis
families.large_gap: six adjacent sites in one transverse row, centered in x
families.secondary_gap: one left boundary site in same row
families.hypothesis: interior reconstruction increases failure strain more than edge reconstruction

families.name: boundary-dominant hypothesis
families.large_gap: six adjacent sites starting on left boundary in one transverse row
families.secondary_gap: one interior site at column 11 in same row
families.hypothesis: edge reconstruction increases failure strain more than interior reconstruction

families.name: negative control
families.hypothesis: no supported geometric repair; no applicable edit is not evidence of causal rejection

held_out.access: not generated until development predictions/analysis code are locked; case-family assignments private and independently permuted

geometric_edit_rule: Infer row spacing and circular row phase from observed coordinates; identify missing supported lattice sites; classify entire reference-adjacent missing-site components by whether they touch the observable external boundary. Reinsert only supported sites. No pristine site IDs or preparation labels.

physical_validation.fracture_rule: unchanged post-global-peak 0.65 load drop plus reference-bond-loss cluster >=4 persisting three samples; null strain if censored
physical_validation.reproducibility: one development replicate rerun fresh; same engine/version numeric outputs equal; ignore walltime/PIDs

holdout_policy: No changes to protocol, geometry, thresholds, hypotheses, allowed tools or seed set after any development result. All development outcomes reported. Held-out generation runs once after a Git lock of development predictions and analysis code. All held-out arms/seed results frozen before privileged scoring. No dropped seeds, cherry-picked cases or reruns chosen by outcome. Failure yields NOT_VALIDATED; no attempt to rescue V1 by changing its criteria.
selection_policy: Single registered design; no parameter search. Development numeric failure stops validation and is reported. Development scientific failure may still be evaluated on the untouched held-out design, without amendments; it must remain disclosed.

inference.modes: offline deterministic registered tools initially; live inference only with successful per-action JSON provenance
inference.public_observations: identical measured geometry, protocol, curves and snapshots available to every comparator
inference.hidden: ID-family map and original lattice site identifiers only in separate private generator/scorer files

scope: Educational 2D reduced-unit SFLJ intervention demonstration; held-out seed and one-row location shift. Not real-material fracture validation or generalization beyond these preparations. Original CASE_ALPHA..DELTA unchanged.
dashboard_policy: Always separate original frozen benchmark from this study. Show registration hash, development vs held-out, validation state, cached vs fresh, seed counts, failed/censored states and model mode. Never describe NOT_VALIDATED data as a successful discovery. Preserve all arms and all seeds.
